## Invitations

A total of 720 invitations were issued during the outreach activity. Attendance was 123, representing a rate of 17.1 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of the response to the invitation process and the number of people who attended. Invitations were used to support engagement across the Hill Counties area, with arrangements made to maintain access where local conditions permitted.

Van days were kept where roads allowed. This approach supported delivery of the outreach activity while recognising that road conditions affected where services could be provided. The invitation and attendance figures should be considered alongside these practical arrangements.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 605 invitees. Reminders went to 0. The contact activity therefore relied on the initial SMS communication, with no additional reminders recorded. These figures are included to support review of the outreach process and to inform future contact arrangements. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
